activity_statements.statement: designs, manufactures, and sells the da Vinci robotic surgery system — the most widely used surgical robot — enabling minimally invasive procedures for surgeons worldwide
manufactures and sells da Vinci instruments and accessories consumed in each surgical procedure, generating recurring per-procedure revenue
sells the Ion robotic bronchoscopy system for minimally invasive lung cancer biopsies
provides 24/7 technical service and support to keep da Vinci systems operational at hospital customers worldwide
operates My Intuitive, a data and insights platform giving surgeons analytics on their robotic procedure performance
provides SimNow surgical simulation training to help surgeons sharpen their robotic technique before operating on patients
expanding direct operations in Europe to increase market presence beyond the historically U.S.-dominated installed base

name_reality_gap: The 'Healthcare Biotech & Pharmaceuticals' industry label from the index is misleading — Intuitive Surgical makes no drugs or biologics. It is a medical device and robotics technology company with a razor-and-blades business model: capital equipment (da Vinci systems) plus high-margin recurring instrument and service revenue.
extraction_notes: About page was highly informative on all product lines and services. Revenue model (razor-and-blades) and recurring revenue structure are well-documented publicly but not explicitly stated on the about page; confidence slightly reduced for those elements.
